title: Listening: A phone call at the station
goal: Understand a short phone call, and practise telling the time and the present continuous.
goal_it: Capire una breve telefonata ed esercitare l'ora e il present continuous.

steps.title: Today's situation
en: You will hear a short phone call between two friends. Sara is at the station. Tom is late.
Listen for two things: what they are doing now, and the times. First, learn the words and the time expressions below.
it: Sentirai una breve telefonata tra due amici. Sara è alla stazione. Tom è in ritardo.
Ascolta due cose: cosa stanno facendo adesso e gli orari. Prima impara le parole e le espressioni dell'ora qui sotto.

steps.title: Words you need
en: Learn these words before you listen.
it: Impara queste parole prima di ascoltare.

steps.title: Telling the time and the present continuous
steps.title_it: Dire l'ora e il present continuous
en: In English we say past for the first half of the hour and to for the second half.
For actions happening now we use am / is / are + verb-ing: I'm walking, he's waiting, they're crossing.
it: In inglese si usa past per la prima mezz'ora e to per la seconda.
Per azioni che succedono adesso si usa am / is / are + verbo-ing: I'm walking, he's waiting, they're crossing.

examples.it: Sono le nove e un quarto.

options: The road is full of cars and you cannot move
You are walking in the street
You are waiting for a taxi
steps.why_it: Stuck significa che non puoi muoverti.

steps.q: Sorry, I'm ___ late. The bus is slow.
steps.q_it: Scusa, sono in ritardo. L'autobus è lento.
steps.why: We say running late for being late.
steps.why_it: Si dice running late per essere in ritardo.

steps.why: Past means minutes after the hour: 9.10.
Quarter to ten is fifteen minutes before ten: 9.45.
steps.why_it: Quarter to ten sono quindici minuti prima delle dieci: 9.45.

steps.why: Present continuous: is + verb-ing. Cross becomes crossing.
steps.why_it: Present continuous: is + verbo-ing. Cross diventa crossing.

steps.title: Listen to the phone call
en: Press Listen. You can listen as many times as you like. Try to find out: Where is Sara? Why is Tom late? What time does the train leave?
it: Premi Ascolta. Puoi riascoltare quante volte vuoi. Cerca di capire: dov'è Sara? Perché Tom è in ritardo? A che ora parte il treno?

script.speaker: Sara
script.text: Hi Tom, it's Sara. Where are you?
script.it: Ciao Tom, sono Sara. Dove sei?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Hi Sara. I'm on the bus, but it's stuck in traffic. I'm getting off now and walking the rest.
script.it: Ciao Sara. Sono sull'autobus, ma è bloccato nel traffico. Scendo adesso e faccio il resto a piedi.

script.speaker: Sara
script.text: Oh no! I'm already at the station. The train leaves at ten past nine.
script.it: Oh no! Io sono già alla stazione. Il treno parte alle nove e dieci.

script.speaker: Sara
script.text: It's five to nine. You have fifteen minutes.
script.it: Sono le nove meno cinque. Hai quindici minuti.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. I'm crossing the bridge now, so I'm nearly there.
script.it: Va bene. Sto attraversando il ponte, quindi sono quasi arrivato.

script.speaker: Sara
script.text: Great. I'm standing next to the coffee shop, opposite the ticket office.
script.it: Bene. Sono accanto al bar, di fronte alla biglietteria.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Perfect. I can see the station. I'm arriving in two minutes.
script.it: Perfetto. Vedo la stazione. Arrivo tra due minuti.

script.speaker: Sara
script.text: Hurry up! I'm waiting for you.

steps.why: Sara says: I'm already at the station.
steps.why_it: Sara dice: I'm already at the station.

options: His bus is stuck in traffic
He is at the wrong station
steps.why: Tom says the bus is stuck in traffic.
steps.why_it: Tom dice che l'autobus è bloccato nel traffico.

steps.q: What time does the train leave?
steps.q_it: A che ora parte il treno?
steps.why: Sara says: ten past nine, that is 9.10.
steps.why_it: Sara dice: ten past nine, cioè 9.10.

steps.q: What time is it during the call?
steps.q_it: Che ore sono durante la telefonata?
steps.why: Sara says: It's five to nine.
steps.why_it: Sara dice: It's five to nine.

steps.why: She says: next to the coffee shop, opposite the ticket office.
steps.why_it: Dice: next to the coffee shop, opposite the ticket office.

steps.title: Listen again with the text
en: Now read and listen at the same time. Notice the present continuous and the times.
it: Ora leggi e ascolta insieme. Nota il present continuous e gli orari.

steps.why: He says: I'm getting off the bus.
steps.why_it: Dice: I'm getting off the bus.

answers: The train leaves at ten past nine
steps.why: Timetables use the present simple: leaves.
steps.why_it: Gli orari usano il present simple: leaves.
steps.audio: The train leaves at ten past nine.

answers: I'm standing next to the coffee shop
steps.audio: I'm standing next to the coffee shop.

answers: Hurry up, I'm waiting for you
Hurry up I'm waiting for you
steps.why: Hurry up! is what we say to tell someone to go faster.
steps.why_it: Hurry up! si dice per far sbrigare qualcuno.
steps.audio: Hurry up, I'm waiting for you.

steps.title: Keep listening this week
en: Choose one short recording at B1 level and listen twice. The first time, listen without help. The second time, read the transcript if there is one.
BBC Learning English also has the programme 6 Minute English: you can find it in your podcast app.
it: Scegli una breve registrazione di livello B1 e ascoltala due volte. La prima volta senza aiuti. La seconda leggi la trascrizione, se c'è.
Anche BBC Learning English ha il programma 6 Minute English: lo trovi nella tua app di podcast.
